Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
Weakness.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization
Weakness.Description: The product does not ensure or incorrectly ensures that structured messages or data are well-formed before being read from an upstream component or sent to a downstream component.

Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
Weakness.Description: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input, but it does not neutralize special elements that could modify the intended SQL command.

Weakness.Name: Improper Input Validation
Weakness.Description: The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.

Weakness.Name: Unintended Proxy or Intermediary ('Confused Deputy')
Weakness.Description: The product receives a request, message, or directive from an upstream component, but the product does not sufficiently preserve the original source of the request before forwarding the request to an external actor.

Weakness.Name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
Weakness.Description: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input, but it does not neutralize special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.

Category.Name: Data Neutralization Issues
Category.Summary: Weaknesses in this category are related to the creation or neutralization of data using an incorrect format.

Category.Name: Validate Inputs
Category.Summary: Weaknesses in this category are related to input validation strategies.
